items.text: Denver FINAL: OUT - S Brandon Jones (hamstring), CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle), DL Eyioma Uwazurike (shoulder). Questionable - S Talanoa Hufanga (ankle), OLB Dondrea Tillman (hip), WR Pat Bryant (ankle, returning from IR). Bo Nix starts.

Carolina FINAL: OUT - OLB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), G Damien Lewis (knee), LB Bobby Okereke (foot), CB Will Lee III (hamstring). Questionable - C Corey Bullock (quad), G Torricelli Simpkins III (ankle), OL Brady Christensen (hamstring). On IR: OTs Taylor Moton and Ikem Ekwonu, CBs Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson. Bryce Young starts.
